messages:
sam: Quick design sync 1: trying an accordion/list hybrid for prompt-set eval runs. Goal: keep scanable for keyboard/SR while saving vertical real estate. Opinions?

nina: Accordion seems better than grid for SR. Make headers real buttons with aria-expanded and role=button. Up/Down to move between headers.

own: Agree. Add a dense toggle for power users so default stays accessible. Dense rows should still include a visible short label (OK/FL) not color-only.

claudia: Bulk-approve flow: select rows -> confirm sheet showing provenance. Don't load full provenance for 200 items up-front; lazy-load details per-row. Modal must trap focus and use aria-live for progress.

harry: Diff rendering note: current inline tags cause reflow. Do overlay highlights with absolutely positioned spans and give tokens tabindex=0 so SR can read "added"/"removed" on focus. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

ui-bot: deploy: ui/accordion-hybrid v1 deployed to staging at 2025-01-10T14:03:00Z

sam: Good. Copy picks: use "Approve selected" for bulk CTA and "Approve" for single. Add tooltip: "Records reviewer and timestamp" with aria-describedby.

nina: Accessibility nit: announce result counts when filters change and when bulk actions complete. Use aria-live=polite element.

own: Keyboard shortcuts: F to focus filter bar, A to toggle select-all. Announce via aria-live when selection changes.

claudia: One more: when expanding a row, show diff summary line at top ("2 additions, 1 removal") so users don't have to parse highlights.

sam: Perfect. I'll update Figma and handoff notes: accordion hybrid, dense toggle, overlay diffs, lazy provenance, bulk-approve modal with accessible copy and live regions. Tagging design + eng for PR demo. React with :thumbsup: to proceed or :eyes: to review copy.

owen: :thumbsup:

harry: :thumbsup:

claudia: :eyes: want to review modal copy before merge.
